title: Mentorship moment → LinkedIn English post
user_request: Hoje um desenvolvedor júnior do meu time resolveu um bug que eu não conseguia resolver há dias
expected_output: Today, a junior developer on my team solved a bug I'd been stuck on for days. Let that sink in. The best leaders aren't the ones who know everything — they're the ones who build environments where everyone gets to be brilliant. I learned something valuable today. Not just about the code.
notes: Input: Portuguese, humble leadership moment. Output: English LinkedIn post. Tone: self-aware, empowering, leadership insight without condescension.
